property_summary: For every caller/address and calldata/amount, calls to sendMoney only succeed (do not revert) when initiated by the contract owner; the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check allows non-owners to invoke sendMoney successfully for some inputs, so the property is that non-owners' calls to sendMoney always revert on the reference but may succeed on the mutant.
change_summary: Relax the access check to allow any caller (remove ownership requirement), changing who can call sendMoney and thus externally observable behavior.
